about_the_game:
Blue Book is a visual novel in the detective and science fiction genres. Become an FBI agent and investigate the disappearance of people in a small town. Play out different behavior patterns to interrogate locals and notice inconsistencies in their testimonies. Discover the truth: are UFOs behind these kidnappings?

Open World. Immerse yourself in the atmosphere of Rosland — a small provincial town in Kansas in the mid-1980s. Freely move around the police station, hospital, library, and a variety of other locations. Explore every corner to uncover the full truth about what’s happening in the town.

Action Cards. Pressure witnesses, take on the role of the “good” and the “bad” cop, show friendliness, slam your fist on the table, joke, or be serious — the visual novel gives you the opportunity to choose action cards depending on the situation.

Evidence System. Collect important evidence for your investigation. Carefully examine the clues you find. Don’t miss a single detail that can help identify those behind the kidnappings in Rosland.

Hypotheses and Conclusions. Build hypotheses based on conversations with witnesses and victims. Reach logical conclusions from the evidence gathered. But be cautious — every decision will have its consequences.

Unique Dialogues and Unforgettable Characters. You will encounter locals with unique personality traits and behavioral patterns. Use your observation skills and pay close attention to each of them. Maybe the residents of Rosland are not as simple as they seem at the first glance… The unique dialogue system will help you find out for sure.

“Blink” System. Sometimes you will face situations that require immediate and precise reactions. Be attentive and decisive, because hesitation could cost someone’s life.

Puzzles. During your investigation, you will find yourself in places where you’ll need to think carefully about your actions. Only by doing so can you progress further.

Collectible Items. While investigating, you may come across unique items. From them, you’ll learn about the most famous UFO sightings and other mysterious phenomena people have encountered. Keep your eyes open to collect all the collectibles.

Multiple Endings. Complete your investigation with one of three unique endings, each determined by your actions. Don’t be discouraged if the ending disappoints you — you can always start the investigation anew.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-4130 or AMD FX-6300
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 750 Ti / AMD R7 260X / Intel UHD 630
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 1 GB available space

short_description: Blue Book is a visual novel that blends science fiction and detective genres. Investigate mysterious disappearances in a small provincial town as an FBI agent. Interrogate residents, analyze their words, and uncover the secret: are the kidnappings caused by people… or something else?
supported_languages: English, French, German, Spanish - Spain, Simplified Chinese, Russian, Japanese, Portuguese - Brazil
